Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack via compromised software update process
Installer included the Floxif trojan malware that executed on 32-bit systems
Malware collected device details and sent data to remote server
Malware had ability to download and install other programs
Impacted Systems: Windows 32-bit systems running CCleaner versions 5.33.6162 and 1.07.3191
Attack Vector: Compromised software build environment and update process of CCleaner
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of Floxif trojan in CCleaner installer versions 5.33.6162 and CCleaner Cloud v1.07.3191
Malicious activity logs shared by Morphisec customers
Malware C&C server domains registered by Cisco and later taken down
